units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 11b:9">M. Kat. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>היתה מלאכת אחרים בידו אע״פ שבק׳ וכ׳</he> if the mourner has work for others on hand, even if it be contract-labor, he must not work; (emended) <he>בין ק׳ בין שאינה ק׳</he> whether it be contract-labor or not (whether he is paid for the job or by the day. Ib. 12ᵃ <he>מקבלי ק׳ בתוך וכ׳</he> if gentiles take labor on contract within the Sabbath limits (of the Jewish employer), it is forbidden to let them work on the Sabbath. Ib.; Tosef. ib. II, 5 <he>מקבלין ק׳ במועד וכ׳</he> you may contract during the festive week for work to be done after the festival.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:8:3">Y. Sabb. I, 4ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>בין בשכיר בין בק׳</he> whether he is hired by the day or by the piece; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:1:10">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 1:3">Tosef. ib. I, 3</cite> <he>אם היה שְׂכִיר קַבָּלוּת</he> (not <he>שכר</he>) if he was hired by the piece.
